row:
Sports Massage and Soft Tissue Therapy is a constantly evolving discipline. As we learn more about its effects on the body and mind the more we vary its application. 
I teach students techniques to improve posture and create efficiency in movement however the most important lesson is how to individualise each session, treat the individual and collaborate. These video are a great way to revisit old techniques refresh and evolve. 
If you would like to see any massage ideas please fell free to message me.
